Strategy: Combine the sweet band between thirty and forty-five and the mid penalty with a small bonus for nearly exact fits up to five. This rewards three kinds of good leftovers at once, but the extra bonus may rarely trigger and the limits are guesses.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else 0) - (20 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) + (10 if r - item > 0 and r - item <= 5 else 0) for r in bins]
```
